abstract: We measure the nature and severity of a variety of belief distortions in market reactions to hundreds of economic news events by synthesizing structural estimation with algorithmic machine learning to quantify bias. We find that investors systematically overreact to perceptions about multiple fundamental shocks, a phenomenon we show often dampens rather than amplifies market volatility via a “shock composition effect.” Such effects imply that the stock market can underreact to news, even when investors overreact to all shocks. (JEL E7, E27, E32, E17, G4)
abstract_zh: 我们通过将结构估计与算法机器学习相结合，量化了市场对数百个经济新闻事件反应中多种信念扭曲的性质与严重程度。研究发现，投资者系统性地对多重基本面冲击的感知过度反应，这一现象通常通过“冲击构成效应”抑制而非放大市场波动。此类效应表明，即使投资者对所有冲击均过度反应，股票市场仍可能对新闻反应不足。（JEL分类号：E7, E27, E32, E17, G4）
title: What Hundreds of Economic News Events Say About Belief Overreaction in the Stock Market

abstract: Focus Stablecoins – digital tokens with the goal to function as money – offer easy access to US dollar liquidity. As a result, one of the main use cases of stablecoins to date has been to serve as a store of value in emerging market and developing economies. However, relatively little is known about the drivers and behaviour of "stablecoin dollarisation", how it may interact with more conventional forms of dollarisation and how it may affect monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 焦点稳定币——旨在充当货币的数字代币——为获取美元流动性提供了便捷渠道。因此，稳定币迄今的主要应用场景之一，是在新兴市场和发展中经济体充当价值储存手段。然而，关于"稳定币美元化"的驱动因素与行为特征、其与传统美元化形式的潜在互动机制，以及可能对货币政策产生的影响，目前仍知之甚少。
title: Dollarisation and monetary control: what lessons for the rise of stablecoins?
title_zh: 美元化与货币控制：稳定币崛起带来了哪些启示？

abstract: Adoption of organic certification across the EU remains lower than anticipated, with financial risks during and after conversion often cited as barriers. We examine whether farms with stronger financial health (FH) are associated with a higher likelihood of adopting organic certification. Using Farm Accountancy Data Network panel data from 2014 to 2018 covering 24,797 EU farms, we classify farms by FH and apply matching and logit regression to analyse the relationship between preconversion FH and organic certification adoption. Results show no clear association between FH and adoption, while preconversion land-use intensity consistently correlates with organic certification uptake, suggesting relevance for EU policy design efforts.
abstract_zh: 欧盟范围内有机认证的采用率仍低于预期，转型期间及之后的财务风险常被视为障碍。本文探究财务健康状况更佳的农场是否更有可能采用有机认证。基于2014至2018年覆盖24,797个欧盟农场的农场会计数据网络面板数据，我们对农场进行财务健康分类，并运用匹配法和逻辑回归分析转型前财务健康与有机认证采用之间的关系。结果显示，财务健康与有机认证采用之间无显著关联，而转型前土地利用强度始终与有机认证采用呈正相关，这一发现对欧盟政策设计具有参考价值。
title: Deep pockets needed? Financial health and organic certification adoption in the European Union
title_zh: 资金充裕是必需的吗？欧盟有机认证采纳中的财务状况研究

abstract: Mergers are associated with large and persistent earnings declines for incumbent employees in target firms. Linking employer‐employee administrative data with information on merger activity in Brazil, I find the negative effects concentrate on employees who exit target firms and reflect displacement in the short run and wage declines in the long run. Low‐skilled, managerial, and older employees fare worse. Overall, I conclude that mergers are followed by substantial reallocation costs reflecting losses of firm‐specific wage premiums, matching inefficiencies, and industry‐specific human capital depreciation, with employees transitioning to lower paying firms considered to be of lower productivity and employment value.
abstract_zh: 并购与目标企业现有员工的大幅且持续的收入下降相关。通过将巴西雇主-雇员行政数据与并购活动信息相关联，我发现负面效应主要集中在离职的目标企业员工身上，这既反映了短期内的岗位流失，也体现了长期内的工资下降。低技能、管理岗位及年长员工受到的影响更为严重。总体而言，我得出结论：并购之后会出现显著的重新配置成本，这反映了企业特定工资溢价的损失、匹配效率低下以及行业特定人力资本的贬值，员工转而流向被认为生产率和就业价值较低的低薪企业。
title: M&As, Employee Costs, and Labor Reallocation
title_zh: 并购、员工成本与劳动力再配置

abstract: Clarity of responsibility is an essential element of political accountability. We develop a rational model of Bayesian updating in the presence of ambiguous attribution and we test its predictions using an original survey. We show that respondents' partisanship, assessment of public healthcare quality, and beliefs over which layer of government is responsible for healthcare are correlated as predicted: good-assessment voters attribute responsibility to the layer governed by their preferred party, while bad-assessment voters blame the layer governed by the party they dislike. These partisan patterns of credit and blame, often interpreted as evidence of motivated reasoning or partisan bias, can thus arise from rational Bayesian updating under attribution ambiguity. No such partisan patterns exist where the same party is in charge of regional and central government. A survey experiment in which we inform subjects of the official quality of healthcare has them update in the predicted, partisan, direction. Model and empirical results show that partisan priors are extremely hard to dislodge when attribution is ambiguous.
abstract_zh: 责任清晰性是政治问责的核心要素。我们构建了一个存在模糊归因情境下贝叶斯更新的理性模型，并通过原创性调查检验其预测。研究表明，受访者的党派倾向、对公共医疗质量的评估以及关于哪级政府负责医疗服务的信念之间存在预测性关联：评估良好的选民将责任归于其偏好政党执政的层级，而评估不佳的选民则将责任归咎于其厌恶政党执政的层级。这种党派性的褒贬模式常被解读为动机性推理或党派偏见的证据，但在归因模糊条件下，它实际上可能源于理性贝叶斯更新。当同一政党同时掌控地区与中央政府时，此类党派性模式便不复存在。在告知受访者官方医疗质量信息的调查实验中，其更新方向与预测的党派性方向一致。模型与实证结果表明，当归因模糊时，党派先验信念极难被撼动。
authors: Ricardo Alonso; Monica Martinez-Bravo; Gerard Padro i Miquel; Carlos Sanz; Silvia Vannutelli
title: Ambiguous Attribution: Theory and Evidence
title_zh: DP21770 模糊归因：理论与证据

abstract: I develop a method that uses the language surrounding places, people, and other entities in dated text to measure their attributes over time, and use it to ask whether a local orientation toward useful knowledge predicts innovation and growth. Patterns of word use form a numerical map, or word embedding, in which fixed word lists define attribute scales for scoring each entity. Neither scales nor scores use outcomes, and publication dates restrict scores to prior text. Applied to 38.6 billion context-word occurrences in nearly 2.7 million English-language works from 1500-1899, the method recovers independently measured elevation and agricultural dependence and combines learning, science, practical improvement, and print in a useful-knowledge index. Within countries, a one-standard-deviation increase in the index is associated with 0.105 standard deviations higher log(1+patents) during 1980-2014 and a 3.4 percentage-point increase in the probability of any patent. The association remains 0.062 standard deviations in 7,011 cells without a recorded birthplace of a notable intellectual. An index reconstructed from pre-1750 contexts predicts 1980-2014 log patenting within countries at 0.053 standard deviations after controlling for textual coverage, with positive estimates in Europe, Asia, and Latin America. Training the embedding solely on pre-1750 text leaves the full-sample association positive. Within countries, the 1500-1899 index also predicts average nighttime light over 1992-2024 and regional GDP per capita in each region's latest available year, 2016-2020. In European cities, the pre-1750 index predicts faster post-1750 growth near coal, a complementarity concentrated in Britain. The findings support Mokyr's view of useful knowledge as a local innovative capacity and an Allen-Mokyr synthesis for Britain's coal-and-steam take-off.
abstract_zh: 我提出一种方法，利用文本中围绕地点、人物及其他实体的语言，测量其随时间变化的属性，并以此探究对实用知识的地方性取向能否预测创新与增长。词汇使用模式构成数值化地图（即词嵌入），其中固定词表定义属性标尺，用于对每个实体进行评分。标尺与评分均不依赖结果变量，且出版日期将评分限定于历史文本。将该方法应用于1500-1899年间近270万部英文著作中的386亿个上下文词汇实例后，该方法成功还原了独立测量的海拔高度与农业依赖度，并将学习、科学、实践改进与印刷术整合为实用知识指数。在国家层面，该指数每增加一个标准差，1980-2014年间log(1+专利数)提高0.105个标准差，且产生任何专利的概率上升3.4个百分点。在7011个未记录著名知识分子出生地的单元格中，该关联仍保持0.062个标准差。基于1750年前文本重建的指数，在控制文本覆盖范围后，可预测1980-2014年国家内log专利数达0.053个标准差，且欧洲、亚洲与拉丁美洲均呈现正向估计值。仅以1750年前文本训练词嵌入后，全样本关联仍保持正向。在国家层面，1500-1899年指数还可预测1992-2024年平均夜间灯光强度，以及各地区最新可用年份（2016-2020年）的区域人均GDP。在欧洲城市中，1750年前指数可预测1750年后煤炭资源附近更快的增长，这种互补性集中体现在英国。研究结果支持Mokyr关于实用知识作为地方创新能力的观点，以及英国煤炭与蒸汽腾飞的Allen-Mokyr综合解释。
title: Measuring the Culture of Useful Knowledge and the Roots of Innovation
title_zh: DP21769 衡量有用知识文化及创新根源

abstract: This paper studies how spillovers across complementary markets shape product variety and firm entry. We examine the Indian cell phone and wireless service markets during the 4G rollout and estimate a structural model of demand, pricing, carrier network expansion, and phone product choice. The estimation results support the economic forces through which complementarity generates spillovers. Counterfactual simulations show that banning budget Chinese phones slows 4G deployment by roughly five quarters and lowers consumer welfare without raising domestic firms' profits. Similarly, an unrestricted subsidy outperforms a domestic-only subsidy in expanding network coverage, increasing consumer welfare, and raising domestic firms' profits.
abstract_zh: 本文研究互补市场间的溢出效应如何影响产品多样性与企业进入。我们以印度4G网络部署期间的手机与无线服务市场为研究对象，构建了涵盖需求、定价、运营商网络扩张及手机产品选择的结构模型。估计结果证实了互补性产生溢出效应的经济机制。反事实模拟表明：禁止廉价中国手机将使4G部署延迟约五个季度，并降低消费者福利，但不会提升本土企业利润；同样，无限制补贴在扩大网络覆盖、提升消费者福利及增加本土企业利润方面均优于仅限本土企业的补贴方案。
authors: Chirantan Chatterjee; Ying Fan; Debi Prasad Mohapatra
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象、数据、制度背景均为印度市场，中国仅作为反事实模拟中的变量出现，非核心研究对象。
title: Spillover Effects in Complementary Markets: A Study of the Indian Cell Phone and Wireless Service Markets
title_zh: DP21768 互补市场中的溢出效应：印度手机与无线服务市场研究

abstract: Using the universe of incorporated firms in the United Kingdom, we document that long term debt that is not secured by specific corporate assets (commonly referred to as cash-flow-based debt) is ubiquitous, even among very young firms. Consistent with cash-flow-based lending depending on firms' continuation value, both the timing and the amount of cash-flow-based debt at first financing are strongly related to future performance. In fact, the age at which firms first access cash-flow-based long-term debt is a strong predictor of firm outcomes up to twenty years later. In contrast, the age at which firms access asset-based lending does not predict future performance. To understand how lending based on continuation value impacts firm dynamics, we develop a tractable theory of firm life cycle dynamics with permanent heterogeneity and financing frictions -- where access to finance can be based on signals of both current and future performance. The model highlights the importance of financing based on future value in matching the predictability of cash-flow-based financing observed in the data. It also highlights how frictions to financing based on available collateral vs. future value lead to differential selection and hence very different distributions of firms that survive and grow. The degree to which firms can access financing based on future value is therefore fundamentally intertwined with aggregate firm dynamics.
abstract_zh: 基于英国全部注册公司的数据，我们发现未以特定企业资产担保的长期债务（通常称为现金流债务）普遍存在，即便是非常年轻的企业也不例外。与现金流贷款依赖企业持续经营价值这一逻辑一致，首次融资时现金流债务的时机和规模均与未来业绩密切相关。事实上，企业首次获得现金流长期债务的年龄，能够强有力地预测其后长达二十年的经营表现。相比之下，企业首次获得资产担保贷款的年龄则无法预测未来业绩。为理解基于持续经营价值的贷款如何影响企业动态，我们构建了一个包含永久异质性和融资摩擦的企业生命周期动态理论模型——其中融资可得性可同时基于当前业绩和未来业绩的信号。该模型凸显了基于未来价值的融资在匹配数据中观察到的现金流融资可预测性方面的重要性，同时揭示了基于现有抵押品与基于未来价值的融资摩擦如何导致差异化选择，进而形成截然不同的存活与成长企业分布。因此，企业基于未来价值获取融资的能力与总体企业动态存在根本性关联。
authors: Martin Aragoneses; Chris Hansman; David Licher; Ramana Nanda
title: The Nature of Firm Financing and Growth
title_zh: DP21767 企业融资的性质与增长

title: Information Paths and Learning in Games: Experimental Evidence
title_zh: 信息路径与博弈中的学习：实验证据

abstract: As the postwar international order fragments and universal agreement becomes increasingly elusive, policymakers face a pressing question: what form of cooperation can replace the postwar hegemon-led, rules-based system? This column examines two complementary answers. Mark Carney argues that coalitions of middle powers can preserve stability, resilience, and strategic autonomy in an era of great-power rivalry. The author of this column proposes a broader architecture of pivotal power coalitions organised around human flourishing, policy alignment, and polycentric governance. Their dialogue illuminates one of the defining policy challenges of our time: how to combine geopolitical realism with effective collective action. Together, these approaches offer a practical roadmap for building a more resilient, cooperative, and problem-solving world order.
abstract_zh: 随着战后国际秩序碎片化，普遍共识愈发难以达成，政策制定者面临一个紧迫问题：何种合作形式能够取代战后由霸权主导、基于规则的国际体系？本专栏探讨了两种互补的答案。马克·卡尼认为，中等强国联盟可以在大国竞争时代维护稳定、韧性与战略自主。本专栏作者则提出一个更宏大的架构，即围绕人类繁荣、政策趋同与多中心治理构建关键力量联盟。两者的对话揭示了当代最具挑战性的政策议题之一：如何将地缘政治现实主义与有效的集体行动相结合。这些路径共同为构建更具韧性、更富合作精神且能有效解决问题的世界秩序提供了切实可行的路线图。
title: Rebuilding the world order: Two strategies for a fragmented world
title_zh: 重建世界秩序：碎片化世界的两种策略

abstract: Can energy-rich developing countries convert cheap electricity into AI compute exports? This paper develops a capacity-constrained trade model of AI compute services with bilateral frictions in delivery, regulation, and trust. Calibrating the model across 85 countries shows that several developing economies can produce compute at low cost, but this advantage rarely becomes export competitiveness. Because hardware dominates unit costs and is globally priced, cross-country production costs differ by only 12–20 percent. Modest regulatory, financing, and trust frictions can therefore erase the gains from cheap power. The binding constraint is institutional credibility rather than electricity prices, including enforceable data governance, stable regulation, credible power contracts, access to finance, and geopolitical alignment with buyers.
abstract_zh: 能源丰富的发展中国家能否将廉价电力转化为人工智能算力出口？本文构建了一个受容量约束的人工智能算力服务贸易模型，该模型纳入了交付、监管和信任方面的双边摩擦。通过对85个国家的模型校准发现，部分发展中经济体能够以低成本生产算力，但这种优势很少能转化为出口竞争力。由于硬件成本在单位成本中占主导地位且具有全球统一定价特征，各国间生产成本差异仅为12%-20%。因此，适度的监管、融资和信任摩擦足以抵消廉价电力带来的收益。制约发展的关键因素并非电价，而是制度可信度，包括可执行的数据治理、稳定的监管环境、可靠的电力合同、融资渠道以及与买方的地缘政治协调。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为全球85国，未涉及中国数据、政策或制度背景。
journal: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
publisher: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
series: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
source_name: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
title: Cheap Energy Might Not Be Enough: A Trade Model of AI Compute Services
title_zh: 廉价能源可能不够：人工智能计算服务的贸易模型

abstract: Lebanon’s current economic crisis ranks among the worst in recent history. GDP has collapsed by 38% in real terms. The Lebanese lira, which was fixed to the dollar in 1997, has lost more than 98% of its value on the parallel market. The government has defaulted on its debt, and depositors are unable to access their funds held at commercial banks. Consolidated public sector debt, including both government debt and commercial banks’ claims on the Banque du Liban (BdL), represents more than seven times the current GDP. Public services delivery has crumbled. In short, the country is undergoing a debt crisis, a banking crisis, a currency crisis, and a growth collapse. Four years into the crisis, a resolution remains elusive, and each passing day increases the economic and social burdens faced by the population. Given the increasing cost of delaying a resolution, we propose a strategy for Lebanon’s economic recovery that addresses all the dimensions of the crisis while recognizing the need to rapidly kick-start the economic recovery.
abstract_zh: 黎巴嫩当前的经济危机堪称近代史上最严重的危机之一。实际国内生产总值（GDP）暴跌38%。1997年与美元挂钩的黎巴嫩镑，在平行市场已贬值超过98%。政府债务违约，储户无法提取商业银行存款。包括政府债务及商业银行对黎巴嫩央行（BdL）债权在内的公共部门合并债务，已达当前GDP的七倍以上。公共服务体系全面崩溃。简言之，该国正同时经历债务危机、银行危机、货币危机与增长崩溃。危机爆发四年后，解决方案仍遥不可及，而每拖延一日，民众承受的经济与社会负担便愈发沉重。鉴于拖延解决的成本日益攀升，我们提出一项兼顾危机各维度、同时亟需快速启动经济复苏的黎巴嫩经济复苏战略。
authors: Ricardo Hausmann; Ugo Panizza; Carmen Reinhart; Douglas Barrios; Clement Brenot; Jesus Enrique Daboin Pacheco; Clemens Graf von Luckner; Frank Muci; Lucila Venturi
title: Towards a Sustainable Recovery for Lebanon’s Economy
title_zh: 迈向黎巴嫩经济的可持续复苏

abstract: All U.S defense contractors were required to have fully implemented the 110 security requirements included in NIST Special Publication 800-171 entitled “Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations” by 1 January 2018 whenever a system owned, or operated by or for, a contractor processes, stores, or transmits controlled unclassified information (CUI). Despite the mandate, adoption has been minimal, mostly because the requirement is so costly and time-consuming that medium and small firms cannot afford to comply. Since the adoption of security precautions is costly and time-consuming, in this paper, we propose a constrained optimization methodology to examine this issue.
abstract_zh: 所有美国国防承包商均须在2018年1月1日前全面实施NIST特别出版物800-171《非联邦系统与组织中受控非机密信息的保护》中规定的110项安全要求，只要承包商拥有或运营的系统处理、存储或传输受控非机密信息（CUI）。尽管有强制要求，但采纳程度极低，主要原因在于该要求成本高昂且耗时巨大，中小型企业无力承担。由于安全防护措施的采纳既昂贵又耗时，本文提出一种约束优化方法来研究这一问题。
authors: Noa Barnir; Neil Gandal; Tyler Moore; Vincent Scott
title: A Cost-Benefit Approach to Optimizing Security Precaution Adoption
title_zh: 优化安全预防措施采纳的成本效益方法

abstract: We study the interconnection between the productivity and pricing effects of financial shocks. Combining administrative records on firm-level output prices and quantities with quasi-experimental variation in credit supply, we show that a tightening of credit conditions has a persistent, yet delayed, negative effect on firms’ long-run physical productivity growth (TFPQ) but also induces firms to change their pricing policies. Commonly used revenue-based productivity measures (TFPR) — which conflate price and productivity — offer biased predictions regarding the consequences of financial shocks for firms’ productivity growth, underestimating the long-run elasticity of physical productivity to credit supply by half. We also show that the pricing adjustments themselves have productivity implications. Firms use low pricing as a source of internal financing, allowing them to avoid cutting expenditures on productivity-enhancing activities, thereby softening the impact of financial shocks. We incorporate these forces into a quantitative model of firm dynamics to quantify the importance of productivity and pricing dynamics (and their interplay) in driving the scarring effects of financial crises on aggregate productivity and welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了金融冲击对生产率与定价效应之间的相互关联。通过结合企业层面产出价格与数量的行政记录，以及信贷供给的准实验性变化，我们发现信贷条件收紧对企业长期实物生产率增长（TFPQ）具有持久但滞后的负面影响，同时也会促使企业调整其定价策略。常用的基于收入的生产率指标（TFPR）——混淆了价格与生产率——在预测金融冲击对企业生产率增长的影响时存在偏差，将实物生产率对信贷供给的长期弹性低估了一半。我们还发现，定价调整本身对生产率具有影响。企业将低定价作为内部融资来源，从而避免削减对生产率提升活动的支出，进而缓解金融冲击的影响。我们将这些机制纳入一个企业动态定量模型，以量化生产率与定价动态（及其相互作用）在驱动金融危机对总生产率和福利的疤痕效应中的重要性。
authors: Simone Lenzu; David Rivers; Joris Tielens; Shi Hu
title: Financial Shocks, Productivity, and Prices
title_zh: 金融冲击、生产率与价格

abstract: We develop a unified approach to studying cost-price dynamics in the cross-section of firms in order to explain the time series of aggregate inflation, both during normal times and inflation surges. A key novelty is the use of microdata on firms’ prices and production costs to construct an empirical measure of price gaps — the deviation between a firm’s listed and optimal price. We characterize the mapping between price gaps and the size and frequency of price adjustments and take them to the data to test nonparametrically how firms’ pricing strategies align with the predictions of different pricing models, conditional on shocks of different magnitudes. The microdata provide strong evidence of state dependence: the passthrough of costs into inflation increases more than proportionately when the economy is hit by large aggregate shocks. In contrast, in normal times, the frequency of price adjustment is approximately constant, and the microdata conform to the predictions of time-dependent models (e.g., Calvo 1983). Conditional on the path of aggregate cost shocks extracted from the data, a generalized state-dependent pricing model accounts well for both the low and stable inflation of the pre-pandemic period and the nonlinear surge that followed.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种统一的分析框架，研究企业截面中的成本-价格动态，以解释总体通胀的时间序列特征，既涵盖正常时期也涵盖通胀激增时期。一个关键创新在于利用企业价格与生产成本的微观数据，构建价格缺口（即企业标价与最优价格之间的偏离）的实证度量指标。我们刻画了价格缺口与价格调整幅度及频率之间的映射关系，并将其应用于数据中，以非参数方式检验企业在不同冲击强度下定价策略与各类定价模型预测的一致性。微观数据为状态依赖性提供了有力证据：当经济遭受大规模总体冲击时，成本向通胀的传导效应会以超比例方式增强。相比之下，在正常时期，价格调整频率大致保持恒定，微观数据符合时间依赖模型（如Calvo 1983）的预测。基于从数据中提取的总体成本冲击路径，一个广义的状态依赖定价模型能够很好地解释疫情前通胀的低位稳定特征以及随后出现的非线性激增现象。
authors: Luca Gagliardone; Mark Gertler; Simone Lenzu; Joris Tielens
title: Micro and Macro Cost-Price Dynamics in Normal Times and during Inflation Surges
title_zh: 正常时期与通胀飙升期间的微观与宏观成本-价格动态

abstract: This paper specifies a new convenient algorithm to construct policy projections conditional on alternative anticipated policy-rate paths in linearized dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) models, such as Ramses, the Riksbank's main DSGE model. Such projections with anticipated policy-rate paths correspond to situations where the central bank transparently announces that it, conditional on current information, plans to implement a particular policy-rate path and where this announced plan for the policy rate is believed and then anticipated by the private sector. The main idea of the algorithm is to include among the predetermined variables (the 'state' of the economy) the vector of nonzero means of future shocks to a given policy rule that is required to satisfy the given anticipated policy-rate path.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的便捷算法，用于在线性化动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型（如瑞典央行的主要DSGE模型Ramses）中，构建基于替代性预期政策利率路径的政策预测。此类包含预期政策利率路径的预测，对应于中央银行在现有信息条件下透明地宣布其计划实施特定政策利率路径，且该宣布的政策利率计划被私人部门相信并预期的情况。该算法的核心思想是，在预定变量（即经济“状态”）中纳入未来对给定政策规则冲击的非零均值向量，该向量需满足给定的预期政策利率路径。
title: Anticipated Alternative Instrument-Rate Paths in Policy Simulations
title_zh: DP8176 政策模拟中预期的替代性利率路径

abstract: Stochastic general equilibrium models of small open economies with occasionally binding financial frictions are capable of mimicking both the business cycles and the crisis events associated with the sudden stop in access to credit markets (Mendoza, 2010). In this paper we study the inefficiencies associated with borrowing decisions in a two-sector small open production economy. We find that this economy is much more likely to display "under-borrowing" rather than "over-borrowing" in normal times. As a result, macro-prudential policies (i.e. Tobin taxes or economy-wide controls on capital inflows) are costly in welfare terms in our economy. Moreover, we show that macro-prudential policies aimed at minimizing the probability of the crisis event might be welfare-reducing. Our analysis shows that there is a much larger scope for welfare gains from policy interventions during financial crises. That is to say that, within our modelling approach, ex post or crisis-management policies dominate ex ante or macro-prudential ones.
abstract_zh: 具有偶尔约束性金融摩擦的小型开放经济体的随机一般均衡模型，能够模拟与信贷市场准入突然停止相关的经济周期和危机事件（Mendoza, 2010）。本文研究了两部门小型开放生产经济中借贷决策相关的低效率问题。我们发现，在正常时期，该经济体更可能出现"借贷不足"而非"借贷过度"的现象。因此，宏观审慎政策（如托宾税或对资本流入的全面控制）在我们的经济体中会产生福利成本。此外，我们证明，旨在最小化危机事件发生概率的宏观审慎政策可能反而降低福利。我们的分析表明，在金融危机期间，政策干预带来的福利收益空间要大得多。也就是说，在我们的建模框架内，事后或危机管理政策优于事前或宏观审慎政策。
authors: Alessandro Rebucci; Gianluca Benigno; Christopher Otrok; Huigang Chen; Eric Young
title: Financial Crisis and Macro-Prudential Policies
title_zh: 金融危机与宏观审慎政策

abstract: It is customary to suggest that the asymmetry in the transmission of oil price shocks to real output is well established. Much of the empirical work cited as being in support of asymmetries, however, has not directly tested the hypothesis of an asymmetric transmission of oil price innovations. Moreover, many of the papers quantifying these asymmetric responses are based on censored oil price VAR models which recently have been shown to be invalid. Other studies are based on dynamic correlations in the data that do not shed light on the central question of whether the structural responses of real output triggered by positive and negative oil price innovations are asymmetric. Recently, a number of new methodologies have been introduced and applied to the problem of testing and quantifying asymmetric responses of U.S. real economic activity to positive and negative oil price innovations. Our objective is to put this literature in perspective, to contrast it with more traditional approaches, to highlight directions for further research, and to reconcile some seemingly conflicting results reported in the literature.
abstract_zh: 通常认为，石油价格冲击对实际产出的非对称传导已得到充分证实。然而，多数被引证支持非对称性的实证研究并未直接检验石油价格冲击的非对称传导假设。此外，许多量化这些非对称响应的论文基于经审查的石油价格VAR模型，而此类模型近期已被证明无效。另一些研究则依赖数据中的动态相关性，未能阐明核心问题——即正向与负向石油价格冲击所引发的实际产出结构性响应是否具有非对称性。近年来，一系列新方法被引入并应用于检验与量化美国实际经济活动对正负石油价格冲击的非对称响应。本文旨在系统梳理该领域文献，将其与传统方法进行对比，指出未来研究方向，并调和文献中看似矛盾的若干结论。
title: Nonlinearities in the Oil Price-Output Relationship
title_zh: 石油价格与产出关系中的非线性特征

abstract: In this chapter we present a selective analytic survey of some of the main results of trade under oligopoly. We concentrate on three topics: oligopoly as an independent determinant of trade, as illustrated by the reciprocal-markets model of Brander (1981); oligopoly as an independent rationale for government intervention, as illustrated by strategic trade and industrial policy in the third-market model of Spencer and Brander (1983); and the challenges and potential of embedding trade under oligopoly in general equilibrium as illustrated by the GOLE model of Neary (2002).
abstract_zh: 本章对寡头垄断下贸易的一些主要结果进行了选择性分析综述。我们聚焦于三个主题：寡头垄断作为贸易的独立决定因素，以Brander（1981）的互惠市场模型为例；寡头垄断作为政府干预的独立理据，以Spencer与Brander（1983）的第三市场模型中的战略性贸易与产业政策为例；以及将寡头垄断下的贸易嵌入一般均衡的挑战与潜力，以Neary（2002）的GOLE模型为例。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象、数据、制度背景均不涉及中国，核心模型为一般性寡头贸易理论。
title: Oligopoly and Trade
title_zh: 寡头垄断与贸易

abstract: During the last few decades, many emerging markets have lifted restrictions on cross-border financial transactions. The conventional view was that this would allow these countries to: (i) receive capital inflows from advanced countries that would finance higher investment and growth; (ii) insure against aggregate shocks and reduce consumption volatility; and (iii) accelerate the development of domestic financial markets and achieve a more efficient domestic allocation of capital and better sharing of individual risks. However, the evidence suggests that this conventional view was wrong. In this paper, we present a simple model that can account for the observed effects of financial liberalization. The model emphasizes the role of imperfect enforcement of domestic debts and the interactions between domestic and international financial transactions. In the model, financial liberalization might lead to different outcomes: (i) domestic capital flight and ambiguous effects on net capital flows, investment, and growth; (ii) large capital inflows and higher investment and growth; or (iii) volatile capital flows and unstable domestic financial markets. The model shows how these outcomes depend on the level of development, the depth of domestic financial markets, and the quality of institutions
abstract_zh: 过去几十年间，许多新兴市场国家放宽了对跨境金融交易的限制。传统观点认为，这将使这些国家能够：（i）从发达国家获得资本流入，为更高的投资和增长提供融资；（ii）对冲总体冲击并降低消费波动性；（iii）加速国内金融市场发展，实现更高效的国内资本配置并改善个体风险分担。然而，证据表明这一传统观点是错误的。本文构建了一个能够解释金融自由化实际效应的简单模型。该模型强调国内债务执行不完善以及国内与国际金融交易之间的相互作用。在模型中，金融自由化可能导致不同结果：（i）国内资本外逃，对净资本流动、投资和增长产生模糊影响；（ii）大规模资本流入伴随更高的投资与增长；（iii）资本流动剧烈波动及国内金融市场不稳定。模型揭示了这些结果如何取决于发展水平、国内金融市场深度以及制度质量。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为新兴市场整体，未提及中国数据或政策背景
title: Rethinking the Effects of Financial Liberalization
title_zh: 重新思考金融自由化的效应

abstract: This paper analyses corporate risk choice when firms and their managers have private information regarding firm quality. Managers ? representing themselves or shareholders ? have a short time horizon and wish to boost the firm?s reputation in the market. Investors observe the firm?s current earnings to assess firm quality. Each firm has an opportunity locus for trading off risk and expected return. We show that even risk-neutral managers will choose risk strategically to influence market perceptions. Our model employs the following sequence: (1) a manager learns the firm?s type (good or bad), which determines its opportunity locus relating to risk and expected return; (2) the manager selects a level of risk; (3) a period payoff is reaped; (4) potential purchasers of the firm draw inferences from the period payoff; and (5) the firm is sold in a competitive auction. If firms? choices of risk are observed by the market, pooling behaviour results. Among the pooling equilibria, we show that good firms prefer those with lower variance, which reveal more information, whereas bad firms prefer higher variance equilibria. If risk level choices can only be partially observed, as we expect, and if the market has no strong prior belief about whether firms are good or bad, then good firms will hedge and bad firms will gamble. The latter seek to masquerade as good firms; good firms in turn seek to distinguish themselves. If the market?s prior beliefs are highly unfavourable (favourable), both types gamble (hedge) hoping to alter (avoid refuting) these beliefs. Our empirical evidence confirms our theoretical results when risk choices are not fully observed. Firms with higher returns on assets have less variable performance.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了当企业及其管理者拥有关于企业质量的私人信息时，企业的风险选择行为。管理者——无论是代表自身还是股东——具有短期视野，并希望提升企业在市场中的声誉。投资者通过观察企业当前收益来评估企业质量。每个企业都面临风险与预期收益之间的权衡机会集。研究表明，即使是风险中性的管理者也会策略性地选择风险以影响市场认知。我们的模型采用以下顺序：（1）管理者获知企业类型（优质或劣质），该类型决定了其风险与预期收益的机会集；（2）管理者选择风险水平；（3）获得期间收益；（4）企业潜在购买者根据期间收益进行推断；（5）企业通过竞争性拍卖出售。若市场可观测到企业的风险选择，则会产生趋同行为。在趋同均衡中，优质企业偏好方差较低的均衡（能揭示更多信息），而劣质企业则偏好方差较高的均衡。若风险水平选择仅能被部分观测（如预期所示），且市场对企业优劣无强烈先验信念，则优质企业会进行对冲，劣质企业会进行赌博。后者试图伪装成优质企业，而优质企业则力求区分自身。若市场先验信念极为不利（有利），则两类企业均会赌博（对冲），以期改变（避免否定）这些信念。当风险选择未被完全观测时，我们的实证证据证实了理论结果：资产收益率较高的企业，其业绩波动性较低。
authors: Richard Zeckhauser; François Degeorge; Boaz Moselle
title: Hedging and Gambling: Corporate Risk Choice when Informing the Market
title_zh: DP1520 对冲与赌博：信息披露情境下的企业风险选择

title: Institutions and Labour Reallocation
title_zh: 制度与劳动力再配置

abstract: In this paper we develop a stochastic dynamic general equilibrium model of the Greek economy, in the real business cycle modelling tradition. Household preferences depend on private and public consumption and leisure. Government finances its investment, consumption and transfer payments by means of a proportional income tax rate. Households buy and sell foreign assets in an international capital market and also receive transfer payments from abroad. The volatility, persistence, and co-movement properties of the business cycle component of the data generated by the model are broadly consistent with the actual behaviour of the corresponding actual data of the Greek economy, in 1960?92. We use the model to investigate the response of major macroeconomic variables to temporary and permanent changes in government policy variables, foreign transfers and the rate of return on foreign assets.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个基于实际经济周期建模传统的希腊经济随机动态一般均衡模型。家庭偏好取决于私人消费、公共消费及闲暇。政府通过比例所得税率为其投资、消费及转移支付提供资金。家庭在国际资本市场上买卖外国资产，并接收来自国外的转移支付。模型生成数据中经济周期成分的波动性、持续性及协同变动特征，与1960-1992年间希腊经济实际数据的对应表现基本一致。我们利用该模型考察了主要宏观经济变量对政府政策变量、国外转移支付及外国资产回报率的暂时性与永久性变化的响应。
title: A Stochastic Dynamic General Equilibrium Model for Greece
title_zh: DP1518 希腊随机动态一般均衡模型

title_zh: 德国经济激励与住院率

abstract: The paper proposes an intertemporal equilibrium model with monopolistic competition and start-up investment with variable capacity to explain the nexus between business formation and medium-run growth. An investment externality is identified that results in under-accumulation of capital in the decentralized market equilibrium and, thus, creates investment multipliers. Some form of investment promotion is called for. The paper compares the effectiveness of policies to promote small business formation with a general investment tax credit.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含垄断竞争与可变产能初创投资的跨期均衡模型，用以解释企业形成与中期增长之间的关联。研究发现存在一种投资外部性，导致分散市场均衡中的资本积累不足，进而产生投资乘数效应。因此需要采取某种形式的投资促进政策。本文比较了促进小企业形成的政策与一般性投资税收抵免的有效性。
title: Business Formation and Aggregate Investment
title_zh: 企业形成与总体投资

abstract: This paper provides strategic foundations for the insight that the bargaining power of employees depends on the firm?s labour turnover costs. The analysis shows how these costs determine the firm?s degree of substitutability between two sets of wage negotiations: (i) those the firm conducts with its incumbent employees; and (ii) the alternative negotiations it could conduct with new job seekers. In this context, labour turnover costs not only influence the negotiators? alternatives to bargaining (i.e. the negotiators? fall-back positions and outside options); they affect the nature of the bargaining process itself. This approach leads to a new theory of wage determination.
abstract_zh: 本文为“员工议价能力取决于企业劳动力流动成本”这一洞见提供了战略基础。分析表明，这些成本如何决定企业在两类工资谈判之间的替代程度：（i）企业与现有员工进行的谈判；（ii）企业可能与新求职者进行的替代性谈判。在此背景下，劳动力流动成本不仅影响谈判者的议价替代方案（即谈判者的退路位置和外部选择），还影响谈判过程本身的本质。这一方法引出了一个新的工资决定理论。
title: On the Foundations of Wage Bargaining
title_zh: 论工资谈判的基础

abstract: Using a variant of the Cagan model with rational expectations, this paper shows that expected stabilization can result in a budget deficit in excess of the maximum inflation tax. A cap on the deficit dampens inflation expectations and raises real balances, thus increasing the yield of the inflation tax for any given rate of inflation. This study extends the work of Drazen and Helpman (1990) by including a stochastic budgetary process and using option pricing theory. It uses parameter values of the semi-elasticity of demand for money to provide estimates of the maximum viable real deficit.
abstract_zh: 本文采用带有理性预期的卡甘模型变体，论证了预期稳定化可能导致预算赤字超过最大通胀税。赤字上限抑制了通胀预期并提高了实际货币余额，从而在给定通胀率下增加了通胀税的收益。本研究通过引入随机预算过程并运用期权定价理论，拓展了德拉曾与赫尔普曼（1990）的研究成果。基于货币需求半弹性参数值，本文提供了最大可行实际赤字的估算值。
title: Hyperinflation and Stabilization: Cagan Revisited
title_zh: 恶性通货膨胀与稳定：卡甘再探
